verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing claims cross-team coordination of initiatives (jira-docs-8) and company-level visibility into progress toward top priorities as projects advance (jira-docs-14). Both point toward multi-project roll-up, but they are only glancing feature-page claims. They do not describe a dedicated portfolio view or how progress is aggregated. Missing for 10: a documented portfolio/roll-up view, a description of how progress aggregates across projects, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
